message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) resulted in roughly **47,000 casualties** in total:

| Side | Approximate casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|---------------------------------------------------|
| Allied (British, Dutch, Belgian, Prussian) | ~22,000 |
| French | ~25,000 |

These figures are widely cited by historians and reflect the combined losses of both armies during the engagement.
